conventions.frames: release v2 .motion frames at 60 fps (COMMON body order = MJCF order); t = frame / fps
conventions.braces: body-body contacts kept closed (labels v2 configured pairs)
conventions.free: zones that must stay off the floor in the phase (not planted, state known at both ends: planted or the sidecar's known free); a zone in an event's make set may touch down inside that event's window only
conventions.touch_allowed: body-body touches the reviewer allows at the endpoint (not braces; never charged)
conventions.events: contact changes between consecutive configurations; t_range_s = the event's admissible time since the departure, from the phases' duration ranges
conventions.planted_anchor: zones planted at both ends: the generator keeps them fixed (T2 re-anchors D on them)

duration_bases.hands_inverted: x0 hands-anchored transitions with an inverted end: inter-hold time p10/p50/p90 (corpus_timing)
duration_bases.tripod_to_arm: human tripod -> legs-on-arms -> arm balance passages in Koundinya -a/-b and Side Crow -b
duration_bases.jump_back: no human jump-back in the corpus: flight bounded by ballistics, landing by arrival dwell
duration_bases.settle: arrival settle: the shortest trusted hold window in the corpus is 0.3 s; 1 s keeps the edge short

edges.label: crow -> handstand (press)
edges.risk: the press: shoulder and wrist torque mid-pike may exceed the plant (endpoint wrists s* 0.17 / 0.32); if statics says so the edge becomes a hop (Scorpion -b's pattern) or is dropped

phases.name: lift_tuck
phases.note: shins leave the upper arms; the hips rise over the shoulders with the knees tucked to the chest (inverted tuck); the COM stays over the hands

phases.name: extend
phases.note: the legs extend to the handstand exemplar

phases.name: float_back
phases.note: braces break, the legs shoot back; the COM leaves the hand polygon (0.079 -> 0.318 m behind the hands) before the feet land

phases.name: land
phases.note: feet make (peak vertical force <= 3 BW); the landing loads bent elbows

edges.label: handstand -> crow (lower)
edges.risk: the braces close on rigid colliders

phases.name: lower_fold
phases.note: eccentric: the legs fold and the hips descend behind the hands until the shins reach the upper arms

phases.name: settle
phases.note: both shin braces make on colliders that cannot press in (exemplar gaps -0.1 / +0.3 cm)

edges.label: tripod headstand -> crow
edges.risk: low; partial human precedent (Side Crow -b, Koundinya -a/-b go tripod -> legs onto arms -> arm balance)

phases.name: fold_legs
phases.note: the legs fold down from the headstand until the shins reach the upper arms

phases.name: shift_forward
phases.note: both shin braces make; the COM shifts forward over the hands, unloading the head

edges.label: handstand -> chaturanga (float-down)
edges.risk: the highest: 0.826 m 6-body distance, beyond every within-clip edge (max 0.705 m)

phases.name: overbalance_arc
phases.note: the legs arc over behind the hands as the shoulders move forward

phases.name: land
phases.note: feet make (peak vertical force <= 3 BW); the COM drops 0.73 m onto the wrists and shoulders

phases.name: float_back
phases.note: braces break, the legs shoot back with straight arms

edges.label: firefly -> crow
edges.risk: the Firefly end is weak (tracked 0.613 at e15500, feet down)

phases.name: bend_knees
phases.note: the knees bend and the legs draw back along the arms

phases.name: settle
phases.note: thigh braces swap for shin braces: crow

free_edge.label: squat -> handstand (hop), human capture
free_edge.note: the destination hold does not exist in release v2: R1 labels it (ground set from markers and mat, expected hands) and truncates the clip, which also removes the scorpion gate v2 certified as beyond the plant
